name: @commercetools-labs/transactional-messaging
description: [labs] Send commercetools order and account notifications by email (Twilio SendGrid) and SMS (Twilio), with templates and translations managed in the Merchant Center.

scripts.install:apps: npm --prefix notification-sender install && npm --prefix template-api install && npm --prefix notification-manager install
scripts.build: npm --prefix notification-sender run build && npm --prefix template-api run build && npm --prefix notification-manager run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix notification-sender run typecheck && npm --prefix template-api run typecheck && npm --prefix notification-manager run typecheck --if-present
scripts.lint: npm --prefix notification-sender run lint && npm --prefix template-api run lint && npm --prefix notification-manager run lint --if-present
scripts.test: npm --prefix notification-sender test && npm --prefix template-api test && npm --prefix notification-manager test --if-present
scripts.audit: for d in notification-sender template-api notification-manager; do (cd $d && npm audit --audit-level=critical) || exit 1; done
scripts.preflight: npm run check:shared && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run audit && npm run simulate:connect
